summary: Implemented Graph.cbd(resource) in rdflib/graph.py (last method of Graph, before ConjunctiveGraph) with a nested recursive add_to_cbd helper implementing the W3C CBD rules as specified: subject triples with blank-node expansion guarded by the result, then reifier triples via rdf:subject. Added test/test_graph_cbd.py with CbdTestCase covering the count fixtures (8, 3, 2, 0), reified cases A (8) and B (13), incoming reification, blank-node non-expansion through reification, a blank-node cycle (3), and source immutability. Nothing was run: tests and doctests are unverified and need to be run. No commits were made.
